onHitBlockNorth: execute unless block ~ ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod run setblock ~ ~ ~-1 minecraft:end_rod[facing=north] keep
onHitBlockEast: execute unless block ~ ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod run setblock ~1 ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod[facing=east] keep
onHitBlockSouth: execute unless block ~ ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod run setblock ~ ~ ~1 minecraft:end_rod[facing=south] keep
onHitBlockWest: execute unless block ~ ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod run setblock ~-1 ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod[facing=west] keep
onHitBlockUp: execute unless block ~ ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod run setblock ~ ~1 ~ minecraft:end_rod[facing=up] keep
onHitBlockDown: execute unless block ~ ~ ~ minecraft:end_rod run setblock ~ ~-1 ~ minecraft:end_rod[facing=down] keep
